Step 01 - Standardize the data frame

Source: vignettes/step-01-standardize-df.Rmd
step-01-standardize-df.Rmd

standardize_df() turns a raw Part VII compensation table into the form the rest of the pipeline expects: upper-case titles without periods, numeric hours and pay, and 0/1 checkboxes.

Before and after

Rows of the demo data, as filed and after step 01:

form title, filed title, step 01 hours, filed TOT.HOURS pay, org other pay + benefits TOT.COMP officer box, filed officer box, step 01
990EZ Secretary, Dir SECRETARY, DIR 3 3 0 0 0 NA
990EZ VP, Treasurer & Secretary VP, TREASURER & SECRETARY 2 2 0 0 0 NA
990 Executive Dir. EXECUTIVE DIR 40 40 70098 0 70098 0
990EZ Secretary, Dir. SECRETARY, DIR 1 1 0 0 0 NA
990 dir rec & parks DIR REC & PARKS 40 40 125135 12028 137163 0
990EZ Founder/Board Member FOUNDER/BOARD MEMBER 3 3 0 0 0 NA
990EZ President & Chief Operations Office PRESIDENT & CHIEF OPERATIONS OFFICE 40 40 0 0 0 NA
990 Secretary/Treas SECRETARY/TREAS 1 1 0 0 0 X 1

What it does 

standardize_df()
|
+- check_names()   add any missing compensation or checkbox column (as NA)
+- pre_clean()     upper-case the title and strip periods
+- to_numeric()    hours and the pay components as numbers, blanks as 0
+- to_boole()      checkboxes: "X" -> 1, blank -> 0; NA on a 990-EZ, which has no boxes
  • Keeps the filed title as TITLE_RAW and gives each row a PERSONID.
  • Sums hours at the organization and at related organizations into TOT.HOURS.
  • Sums pay from the organization and from related organizations, other compensation and benefits into TOT.COMP.
  • Converts the trustee, officer, key-employee, highly-compensated and former checkboxes to 1 or 0. A 990-EZ has no checkboxes, so on a 990-EZ they are NA.

Assets

Step 01 uses no crosswalk or word list. It needs the Part VII column names of the NCCS efile schema (F9_07_COMP_DTK_*). See the Workflow article for fetching the tables. tinypartvii is a demo slice in that schema:

data(tinypartvii)
dim(tinypartvii)
#> [1] 81309    33
grep("^F9_07", names(tinypartvii), value = TRUE)
#>  [1] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_EMPL_BEN"          "F9_07_COMP_DTK_NAME_ORG_L1"      
#>  [3] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_NAME_ORG_L2"       "F9_07_COMP_DTK_NAME_PERS"        
#>  [5] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_TITLE"             "F9_07_COMP_DTK_AVE_HOUR_WEEK"    
#>  [7] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_AVE_HOUR_WEEK_RL"  "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_INDIV_TRUST_X"
#>  [9] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_INST_TRUST_X"  "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_OFF_X"        
#> [11] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_KEY_EMPL_X"    "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_HIGH_COMP_X"  
#> [13] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_POS_FORMER_X"      "F9_07_COMP_DTK_COMP_ORG"         
#> [15] "F9_07_COMP_DTK_COMP_RLTD"         "F9_07_COMP_DTK_COMP_OTH"

Try it 

pre_clean(c("Vice President.", "sec/treas.", "Exec. Dir."))
#> [1] "VICE PRESIDENT" "SEC/TREAS"      "EXEC DIR"
d  <- dplyr::sample_n(tinypartvii, 50)
df <- standardize_df(d)
#> [OK] standardize df step complete
df |>
  dplyr::select(TITLE_RAW, F9_07_COMP_DTK_TITLE, TOT.HOURS, TOT.COMP) |>
  head(6)
#>                    TITLE_RAW      F9_07_COMP_DTK_TITLE TOT.HOURS TOT.COMP
#> 1                   DIRECTOR                  DIRECTOR         1        0
#> 2 CHIEF MARKETING & COMM. OF CHIEF MARKETING & COMM OF        40   187972
#> 3                  PRESIDENT                 PRESIDENT         1        0
#> 4                     MEMBER                    MEMBER        20        0
#> 5                  PRESIDENT                 PRESIDENT         0        0
#> 6                         VP                        VP        10        0

Input: a raw Part VII data frame (NCCS efile schema). Output: the same rows with cleaned title text, numeric hours and pay, 0/1 checkboxes and a PERSONID. Continue with step 02.
